entries.text: Ready to go photograph some Pokémon and\nsurvey the forest for me?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_01

entries.text: Reporting for survey duty!
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_select_01

entries.text: Maybe another time...
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_select_02

entries.text: Then let’s hang in the tent until the weather gets\nnice and foggy.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_02

entries.text: Looks like this is about as good as it’s gonna get.\nAll right, partner! Get out there and survey![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_03

entries.text: Took a new photo? Lemme see...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_poke_01

entries.text: That’s the Imitation Pokémon, Sudowoodo! It’s\nreal easy to mistake it for a tree in this fog.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_01

entries.text: The Candle Pokémon, Litwick! Seeing those little\nlights floating in the dark is otherworldly, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_02

entries.text: The Calm Pokémon, Hatenna, huh? Must feel\nright at home in a quiet forest like this.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_03

entries.text: It’s the Rock Pokémon, Geodude! You’ve gotta\nbe careful, or you might trip over this fella![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_04

entries.text: That’s the Toxic Lizard Pokémon, Salandit, right?\nSneaking up on some prey in the dark, maybe?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_05

entries.text: The Stag Beetle Pokémon, Vikavolt! Those huge\njaws it has make for a real killer photo![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_06

entries.text: The Firefly Pokémon, Illumise! Word has it that it\ngets along real well with Volbeat.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_07

entries.text: That’s the Acorn Pokémon, Seedot...right?! Pretty\neasy to mistake it for a Berry or something![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_08

entries.text: That’s the String Spit Pokémon, Spinarak! Do you\nthink it’s trying to spin up a new web in the trees?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_09

entries.text: The Cheeky Pokémon, Skwovet! What would you\nbet it’s looking for food from up in the trees?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_10

entries.text: The Water Weed Pokémon, Lotad! Now that’s\nthe good life, just floating around like that...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_11

entries.text: The EleFish Pokémon, Tynamo! You’ve got a real\nknack for this, spotting something so tiny![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_12

entries.text: The Firefly Pokémon, Volbeat, huh? I heard it can\ndraw shapes using the light on its rear end![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_13

entries.text: The Requiem Pokémon, Duskull... It makes quite\nthe impression on a dark night like this![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_14

entries.text: The Owl Pokémon, Hoothoot! I’ve always wanted\nto get a shot of it switching the foot it stands on.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_15

entries.text: You got both the Firefly Pokémon, Volbeat and\nIllumise! They look so good together. Great shot![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_16

entries.text: The Firefly Pokémon, Illumise! I bet that Volbeat\nshowed up just to be with it, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_17

entries.text: The Firefly Pokémon, Volbeat! I bet that Illumise\nshowed up just to be with it, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_18

entries.text: This is great! I knew you were the right person\nfor the job![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_01

entries.text: You really do take great photos, partner!\c\nHave you tried turning your eyes upward, too?\nThere may be Pokémon lurking up in the trees...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_02

entries.text: You have a real eye for photography, partner!\c\nI bet you could even get great shots of Pokémon\nthat refuse to sit still and always wander around![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_03

entries.text: That’s my partner for you!\c\nYou know, I bet there could be Pokémon in caves\nnearby too. You could probably snap some shots![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_04

entries.text:
You’ve got a real knack for this sort of thing!\c
I bet getting those Pokémon that hang near the
water in the northwest part of the forest would
be a walk in the park for someone like you![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_05

entries.text:
Nice... You’ve done some real fine work here!\c
Oh, one tip from me? Watch your footing when
you get to that area with all the rocks—I tripped
and nearly faceplanted in the dark![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_06

entries.text:
So it looks like you’ve got a real good handle on
how to take photos by now, huh?\c
I bet you even know that some Pokémon are so
wary they’ll run if you get too close! You’ve gotta
be careful if you wanna catch them on film![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_07

entries.text:
You are getting all kinds of different Pokémon
in your photos!\c
It can be tricky—like with Ghost-type Pokémon!
Snapping a photo of one before it disappears
requires a quick shutter finger![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_08

entries.text:
Mm-hmm! You’re getting real practiced at
catching Pokémon out and about their daily lives.\c
I’d guess you could even catch Pokémon up in
the trees searching for their next meal![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_09

entries.text:
Just what I’ve come to expect of my partner!
Your photos really showcase your good taste!\c
Oh, and did you hear that sound coming from the
northeast? Like thunder or something? I wonder
if it could be Electric-type Pokémon...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_10

entries.text:
The composition! The motifs! I think your skills
are wasted here in the backwater, helping me.\c
Oh, but before you abandon me...have you
been up around the water in the northwest?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_11

entries.text: I bet there are still some more Pokémon hiding in\nthe forest you haven’t photographed yet...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_12

entries.text: Well, keep up the good work! I’ve got nothing\nbut high hopes for you, partner![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_poke_02

entries.text: Just one more Pokémon and your survey work\nwill be complete! Keep it up, partner![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_poke_03

entries.text: Huh...? Wait, this picture doesn’t contain a single\nPokémon, does it?![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokemiss_01

entries.text: Ummm... Yeah, I’m not sure the machine will be\nable to process this without a clearer shot...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokemiss_02

entries.text: Nothing new to see here! Try looking for\nPokémon you haven’t photographed yet![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokemiss_03

entries.text: Hmm... Yeah, I don’t think the machine can get\nmuch from images so small. Can’t you get closer?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokemiss_04

entries.text:
Hmm... Looks like the machine can’t use your
photo data.\c
I guess it’s too hard to get a clear reading when
a Pokémon is in the process of running away?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokemiss_05

entries.text: And with that, you’ve completed your survey!\nWell done, partner![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeclear_01

entries.text: Do you want to end your survey early?
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_stop_01

entries.text: End it now
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_select_03

entries.text: Keep going
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_select_04

entries.text: Okay, let’s call it! We’re all done for tonight!
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_stop_02

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_pokenige_01

entries.text: Probably best not to ride on [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]KoMiraidon if the aim\nis to sneak up on Pokémon...
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_ride_01

entries.text: Get Those Photos!
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_ui_01_01

entries.text: Open Camera
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_ui_01_02

entries.text: End Survey
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_ui_01_03

entries.text: How’s the survey coming along, partner?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_talk_01

entries.text: Huh? What’s this? You got a shot of me?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_camera_01

entries.text: Heh heh! Did you get a good shot? Hope I didn’t\nlook too stiff or anything![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_camera_02

entries.text: Wow, I’m not used to being on the other side of\na lens. It’s kind of awkward...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_camera_03

entries.text: Gah! Stop, stop, stop! Now I’m all self-conscious\nand can’t look natural! It’s embarrassing![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_camera_04

entries.text: ...OK, for real—I’m not your subject! Take photos\nof Pokémon already, would you![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_camera_05

entries.text: It’s hard to get a good shot crouched down low...
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_camera_01

entries.text: Wa-wow!
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_growlithe_camera_01

entries.text: Aw, you took Growlithe for me? You sweetie!\c\nI mean, sure, it’s no help at all for the survey,\nbut I still love to see his photos![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s1_side02_fieldwork_growlithe_camera_02
